mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) as "totalMember", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_post) as "totalTravel", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_post) as "totalBoard", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE targetType = 'USER') as "reportMemberTotal", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE targetType = 'POST') as "reportBoardTotal" FROM dual

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, rownum as rnum FROM ( SELECT m.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.targetType = 'USER' AND r.seqTarget = m.seqMember) as reportCount FROM member m WHERE 1=1
AND m.status != 2
AND m.name LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' AND m.id LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' AND m.nickname LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
ORDER BY reportCount DESC, m.regDate DESC ) a ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE 1=1
AND status != 2
AND name LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' AND id LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' AND nickname LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'

SELECT m.seqMember, m.id, m.pw, m.name, m.nickname, m.email, m.regDate, m.type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.targetType = 'USER' AND r.seqTarget = m.seqMember) as reportCount FROM member m WHERE m.seqMember = #{seqMember}
